::: {#rem-bayes-deviance-constant}
#### Bayesian deviance and the generalized linear model deviance

This deviance is minus twice the log-likelihood.
A generalized linear model's deviance subtracts the same quantity for the saturated model,
which does not depend on $\vparam$,
so the two differ by a constant that cancels in comparisons between models of the same data.
:::
